caption: The drawing shows an ornately decorated rectangular tray with rounded edges, depicted in a top-down view. The tray has a predominantly dark background with a sheen, appearing black or dark gray in the center, bordered by a gold line. Along the border, there are decorative patterns that include gold-colored leaves and branches, as well as a mesh or lattice design in gold. At the four corners, there are illustrations of two orange-colored fruits with green-yellow leaves attached to each. Below the tray, there is a simple black outline of the tray's side profile, showing its shallow, curved shape. The drawing is signed with the name "Betty Jacob" just below the tray on the right side. The background of the image is plain off-white or beige.
title: Toleware Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
